_note: Dated academic calendar for the roadmap time estimate (FOUR_FEATURES_SPEC 4.2; app/pai_c/roadmap/calendar.py loads and validates it, timeline.py reads it). Built from the research of 2026-10-28 (2026 cycle observed; month numbers derived from 2026 dates). Every event, intake and test keeps its https sources and confidence (official|secondary|uncertain). An empty months list or a null month means not found: the estimate then says 'date not confirmed' and is uncertain; never fill one from memory. BISE Lahore is the proxy for the boards; other boards, DAE, supplementary results, UET class start and most result dates are gaps. Dates move year to year (2025 papers postponed; MDCAT 2026 moved Aug->Sep; MDCAT may move near FSc from 2027, unconfirmed). applies_to.levels are catalog level codes. intakes carry a label shown to the student (no university names) and name study-field families and/or fields (study_fields.json). tests.codes are catalog test codes (choices.tests) a test_attempt record carries and admission_rules entry tests name. degree_years: years by study field key, the fallback when admission_rules.json has no years for the field; the draft's degree-type keys (bs, be, dae) are not study fields and were dropped. Research draft note: DRAFT from research on 2026-10-28. 2026 cycle observed (dates are actual 2026 dates; month numbers derived). Months marked uncertain came from aggregator/social posts, not board PDFs (not opened). Dates shift year to year (2025 BISE papers were postponed in May; MDCAT 2026 was moved Aug 16 -> Sep 20). PM&DC reportedly moves MDCAT close to FSc exams from 2027 (unofficial, unconfirmed). BISE Lahore used as proxy; other boards not verified.
